ID: Tiny hearing aids with easy volume adjustment
Content: I love how tiny these hearing aids are. The battery lasts longer than expected while the charging case itself lasts me the whole week without needing to be recharged. These hearing aids are good for the price. I like that all I have to do to adjust volume is press a tiny button. And to switch the mode I rapidly press the button three times in a row. It would be nice if these also had Bluetooth but besides that, these are great.
